question.text: The contrapositive of the statement "If two triangles are identical, then they are similar" is

options.text: If two triangles are not similar, then they are not identical
If two triangles are not identical, then they are not similar
If two triangles are not identical, then they are similar
If two triangles are not similar, then they are identical

solution.text:
Let, p: Two triangles are identical

q: Two triangles are similar

Clearly, the given statement in symbolic form is p→q.

Contrapositive of p→q is ∼q→∼p

i.e., If two triangles are not similar, then they are not identical.
